questions.question_text: What is the restriction on paper-based reading sections regarding time?
options: You can finish whenever you like
Answers must be completed within the specified time
You can take extra time if needed
questions.explanation: All sections, including reading, have strict time limits and must be completed within the allotted duration.

questions.question_text: Which of the following items is permitted for a paper-based Reading section?
options: A dictionary to look up unknown characters.
A personal mobile phone for emergencies.
Any pen or pencil of your choice.
questions.explanation: For paper-based tests, candidates are required to bring 2B pencils and an eraser for marking answer sheets.

questions.question_text: What is the primary purpose of the Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK)?
options: To provide a travel guide for visitors in China.
To assess the Chinese language proficiency of non-native speakers in daily, academic, and professional life.
To teach students how to write advanced academic papers in Chinese.
To help students learn to cook Chinese food.
questions.explanation: The website describes HSK as an international standardized test to assess Chinese proficiency for various real-life scenarios.

questions.question_text: Which item is allowed for a paper-based reading section?
questions.explanation: Candidates must use standard testing materials; personal items like phones or private scratch paper are prohibited.

questions.question_text: In a paper-based exam, what is the policy regarding scratch paper?
questions.explanation: Only A4 scratch paper provided by the test center is permitted; personal stationery for this purpose is banned.

questions.question_text: What is the consequence of arriving late for the reading section in a paper-based exam?
questions.explanation: Candidates arriving after the start of the reading section are strictly denied admission.

questions.question_text: What is the primary goal of the HSK test?
options: To evaluate second language Chinese proficiency
questions.explanation: HSK is a standardized test assessing the ability of non-native speakers to use Chinese in various contexts.
